tools.description: Read one canonical Actwise context resource. Before using evaluate_idea, first read actwise://capabilities/evaluate/context. Prefer packages.evaluate_session (actwise://capabilities/evaluate/packages/evaluate-session) for the short evaluation session, then call evaluate_idea and present from the loaded package. Modular child URIs remain valid for inspection. Use only registered actwise:// URIs. Resource-capable clients may use MCP resources/read instead.

known_etag.description: Optional ETag of this exact resource already loaded in the current conversation.

uri.description: A registered Actwise runtime resource URI.

tools.name: read_context_resource

tools.description: Submit a structured idea evaluation with session_id only after reading actwise://capabilities/evaluate/context and preferring packages.evaluate_session (actwise://capabilities/evaluate/packages/evaluate-session) for user_submission plus presentation. Resource-capable clients may use MCP resources/read; tools-only clients must call read_context_resource. Do not call this tool as the first step after receiving a rough idea unless the user explicitly asks to submit the current version despite known gaps. Compose arguments from this tool inputSchema and verify its digest against the context index tool_contract. Pass session_id from the context or package read; do not echo submission_context into runtime_context or supply contract_refs. After presenting a result, preserve Actwise context for follow-up questions referring to the result, review, scores, benchmark, confidence, quality, reliability, independence, usefulness or limitations. Apply the packaged evaluation-quality-assessment guidance for result-quality questions; it uses the canonical product explanation. Treat an implicit quality follow-up as Actwise context unless the user explicitly requests an outside opinion.

canonical_payload.description: Normalized idea fields used for scoring and verification.

category.description: Product or business-model category for segmentation and benchmarks.

industry.description: Primary industry taxonomy label for segmentation and benchmarks.

problem.description: Customer problem being solved; concrete pain, not a feature list.

solution.description: What you build and how it addresses the stated problem.

stage.description: Current maturity of the idea or product.

target_customer.description: Who feels the pain and would buy or adopt; a segment, not everyone.

why_now.description: Why this is timely now versus earlier attempts.

client_runtime_sidecar.description: Runtime-only client envelope fields stripped before service-side LLM prompt construction.

coaching_style_profile_delta.description: Optional coaching style delta; never forwarded to scoring LLM prompts.

changed.description: True when the coaching style profile changed in this turn.

confidence.description: Client confidence in the coaching style delta.

patch.description: Opaque patch operations describing the coaching style delta.

source.description: How the delta was produced: explicit, inferred, mixed, or system_default.

idea_revision_lineage.description: Optional iteration lineage for preview progress comparison.

idea_lineage_id.description: Stable client id linking preview/official iterations of one idea.

previous_evaluation_id.description: Prior evaluation id to compare against; null on first revision.

revision_summary.description: Short summary of what changed since the previous evaluation.

revision_target_lens.description: Dimension this revision aimed to improve; null if none.

oneOf.description: One of the seven Actwise evaluation dimensions.

visibility.description: Marker that sidecar fields are runtime-only and not LLM-visible.

evaluation_mode.description: preview: lens percentiles only, no LLM or baseline write (default). official: full verification path for end-of-ideation standing.

idempotency_key.description: Optional key to dedupe retries of the same submission; null if unused.

metadata.description: Submission provenance and optional display metadata.

company_id.description: Optional company identifier when known; null otherwise.

conversation_depth.description: Count of substantive conversation turns before submission.

idea_title.description: Optional display title for official evaluation Markdown (IMPL-26 Phase 3).

linkedin_connected.description: Whether the submitter has LinkedIn connected for profile enrichment.

submission_source.description: Who originated the submission: user, seed, or internal test.

subscriber_id.description: Optional subscriber identifier when known; null otherwise.

template_completion_score.description: 0–1 completeness of structured template fields before submit.

user_segment.description: Optional analytics segment label; null if unknown.

official_authorization.description: Required when evaluation_mode is official. Records why the user authorized quota consumption.

basis.description: Why the client is authorized to consume official evaluation quota. Completing preview alone is not authorization.

session_id.description: Opaque evaluate session from context or evaluate-session package read (IMPL-45). Required for user submissions.

submitted_scoring.description: Client-composed scores and rationales verified under CT-03.

deviations.description: Strongest and weakest dimensions in the submitted profile.

strongest.description: Dimension the idea is relatively strongest on.

weakest.description: Dimension that most limits standing; coach here first after evaluation.

dimension_scores.description: Per-dimension scores 0–100 matching the evaluation rubric.

customer_clarity.description: How clearly the primary buyer/user and use case are defined (0–100).

distribution_potential.description: How realistically the idea can reach customers (0–100).

insight_strength.description: How non-obvious and defensible the insight or wedge is (0–100).

market_potential.description: How large and reachable the opportunity looks (0–100).

moat_potential.description: How durable competitive advantage could become (0–100).

problem_urgency.description: How painful and time-sensitive the problem is for the target customer (0–100).

timing.description: How favorable current market and timing conditions are (0–100).

overall_score.description: Optional overall score 0–100; server may recompute per contract.

score_rationale.description: Per-dimension rationale text supporting each score.

customer_clarity.description: Evidence-backed rationale for the customer_clarity score.

distribution_potential.description: Evidence-backed rationale for the distribution_potential score.

insight_strength.description: Evidence-backed rationale for the insight_strength score.

market_potential.description: Evidence-backed rationale for the market_potential score.

moat_potential.description: Evidence-backed rationale for the moat_potential score.

problem_urgency.description: Evidence-backed rationale for the problem_urgency score.

timing.description: Evidence-backed rationale for the timing score.

verdict_hints.description: Up to two short hints summarizing the scoring stance.

tools.name: evaluate_idea
